- A **screen pass** is a common football play, especially in the NFL.  
- The **NFC divisional round** is part of the NFL playoffs.

If he were playing in the **NFC divisional round**, that would mean he was on an NFC team, which he has not been in his NFL career.  

So the scenario is **not plausible** because of the conference mismatch.
